items.title: Printing Issue with Creality Halot Mage S 14K – One Side Prints Perfectly, the Other Doesn’t
items.blurb: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing a recurring printing issue with my Creality Halot Mage S 14K , and I'd like to know if anyone else has encountered the same problem. As you can see in the photos, one part of the model prints perfectly, with all the details clearly reproduced, while the opposite s...
items.originalText: Printing Issue with Creality Halot Mage S 14K – One Side Prints Perfectly, the Other Doesn’t Hello everyone, I’m experiencing a recurring printing issue with my Creality Halot Mage S 14K , and I’d like to know if anyone else has encountered the same problem. As you can see in the photos, one part of the model prints perfectly, with all the details clearly reproduced, while the opposite side shows significant defects : incomplete printing, deformations, and areas where the resin doesn’t seem to have cured properly. This issue occurs with different models and two different resins : Fast Cast SuperCast (pink) Liqcreate Wax Castable (blue) I’ve already tried several prints, adjusting the exposure settings, model orientation, and support configurations, but haven’t been able to solve the problem. The printer is properly leveled, the workshop temperature is around 22°C (72°F), and the UV screen appears to be working correctly. What puzzles me most is that two opposite areas of the same model, printed simultaneously, show completely different results . Has anyone experienced this issue, particularly with this printer? Do you have any idea what might be causing it (UV screen, vat film, exposure settings, peeling forces, or something else)? And most importantly, has anyone found a solution? Thanks in advance for your help and advice!
items.author: user7431296185

items.blurb: I am experiencing a serious issue with my Creality HALOT SKY 2022 resin printer. The printer turns on normally, the UV LEDs work, and the mirror is clean. However, the LCD does not display any layer image during printing, and the problem persists even after installing a brand new original 9.25'' ...
items.originalText: HALOT SKY 2022 – LCD does not display layer image even after screen replacement I am experiencing a serious issue with my Creality HALOT SKY 2022 resin printer. The printer turns on normally, the UV LEDs work, and the mirror is clean. However, the LCD does not display any layer image during printing, and the problem persists even after installing a brand new original 9.25’’ 6K mono LCD. Description of the problem: · During printing, the UV backlight turns on, but the LCD remains completely dark. · No layer pattern is projected on the LCD surface. · Running Clean Screen also produces the same result: the entire center area stays dark. Actions already taken: 1. Installed a brand new original LCD panel (9.25’’ 6K mono) specifically made for HALOT SKY 2022. But, no improvement. Please advise: 1. How to properly diagnose whether the issue is the LCD driver board or mainboard? 2. Do you have official replacement parts for the HALOT SKY 2022: · LCD driver board · Ribbon cable · Mainboard (if required) I can provide photos and videos if needed. Thank you in advance. Looking forward to your assistance.

items.originalText: Hello everyone Hello Everyone! My name is Keagan Stephens, all the way from SA! I am 31 years old ,I Live in Eshowe Kwa-Zulu natal 3815 (ZULULAND!) and i Am a Qualified Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant And the owner of Sculptured Realities. My 3d printing Journey Started about 6months ago when i was trying to find a way to make a toy replica of my daughter and had asked a friend of mine whom if fortunate enough to own a Creality Ender KE. I Loved the results and got the cheapest 3d printer i could find which i still use today (easythreed k9 and k10). this was 5 months ago , since then I saved up to get a Creality Halot r6 WHICH WAS ON SALE AT THE TIME. I Really loved the quality prints i got from the Halot R6 and decided to open a business based around 3d Prints specifically aiming to make life like busts that resemble clients likeness, which has gone amazingly well especially since i’ve been unemployed for the past 2 years due to a major unemployment rate the country is facing . since starting i’ve been working with our local bakers trying to fill in the gap by bringing affordable cake toppers and baking related tools such as cookie cutters and stencils etc(we live in a remote area)..i am also currently working on fun kids theme pot planters ,lamps and articulated toys ,keychains and much more which i believe will get kids to get excited about 3d printing and nature as a whole. My future goals for myself and my company is to move on to larger life sized 3d printing aswell as move on to automotive 3d printing applications (mainly engine and interior trimming aswell as afew designer parts). We also aim to start 3d printing lessons for kids which require more high speed printers as so we can print small mini objects evert session which wont take aslong as they do on my current fdm printers. My hopes for this forum and journey as a whole would be to learn more on 3d printing applications and related software, improve my designing skills aswell as simply just to get inspired on my next design. I am also here to learn more about Creality as a brand and Make and hopefully become a pioneer of the brand in future.

We just have to wait a little longer for them to become available. You got your bed a lot better, remember you started with 1.2, that was like a Farfal...
items.originalText: K2 Series Flagship Printers - Bed Leveling and Maintenance Bed Leveling: I’ve done a perfect bed leveling on my K2 Pro. There’s no need for extreme measures. I leveled the bed using the Paper Method, turning the knobs to perfection. I didn’t need sanding, aluminum tape, or anything else. It went from 0.45 to 0.25. Even when it was tilted, my printer was printing flawlessly. You can follow this official Creality video tutorial to perform your leveling, the leveling method starts at 6:24. You must fine-tune each corner at least four times in a circular pattern because when you fine-tune one knob, you mess with the level on the other side. Don’t forget to perform all calibrations after you leveled the bed. You can access the Fluidd web interface by entering the printer’s IP address in your internet browser, plus the door :4408 (example: http://192.168.1.3:4408/ ). Maintenance: I also recommend everybody to perform frequent maintenance on your printers, they will last longer and the printing results will be perfect. Apart from the normal maintenance you see in the video, I also recommend everybody to lubricate all the rollers on the printer frequently. For that, Creality recommends using only WD-40 Specialist Silicone spray. Check this official Creality video for maintenance tips. WD40 specialist Silicone spray 600×359 8.51 KB Levelling 2x 1920×2319 176 KB
